name: B站用户投稿列表
description: 抓取某个B站用户空间的投稿视频列表（标题/BV号/链接），滚动加载。配合 bilibili-download-video 可逐个下载。

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: B站用户 UID（space.bilibili.com/<uid> 的数字）

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const uid=want('$uid');if(!/\d+/.test(uid))return {ok:false,error:'no-uid',hint:'请传入B站用户 UID（space.bilibili.com/<uid> 的数字）'};const target='https://space.bilibili.com/'+uid+'/video';if(location.href.indexOf(uid)<0){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&location.href.indexOf('/video')<0)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));let byUrl=new Map();const start=Date.now();while(Date.now()-start<20000){for(let y=0;y<=document.body.scrollHeight;y+=700){window.scrollTo(0,y);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));}byUrl=new Map();for(const a of document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/video/BV"]')){const m=(a.getAttribute('href')||'').match(/BV[0-9A-Za-z]+/);if(!m)continue;const url='https://www.bilibili.com/video/'+m[0];const t=(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const prev=byUrl.get(url);if(!prev||t.length>prev.title.length)byUrl.set(url,{title:t.slice(0,120),bvid:m[0],url:url});}if(byUrl.size>=3)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));}window.scrollTo(0,0);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));return {ok:true,uid:uid,count:byUrl.size,videos:[...byUrl.values()].slice(0,Math.max(1,Math.min(Number('$limit')||30,60)))};})()

body.note: 滚动懒加载后按 BV 去重提取
